chunks: Why did they not think over the message? Or has something come to them which had not come to their fathers?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Yadabbaru al-Qawl' in Surah Al-Mu'minun?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cognitive barrier of *taqlid* (blind imitation) of ancestors, urging believers to engage in *tadabbur* (deep contemplation) of the Quran's coherent speech (*al-Qawl*). It contrasts the stagnant tradition of the forefathers with the novel, transformative truth of the revelation, emphasizing that true faith requires active intellectual engagement rather than passive inheritance.
